item.title: Why Liver Pressure Can Persist After HCV Cure, Especially With HIV
item.description: Persistent portal hypertension after HCV cure characterized immunological mechanisms differing by HIV status in advanced cirrhosis. The post Why Liver Pressure Can Persist After HCV Cure, Especially With HIV appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Semaglutide Associated with Optic Neuropathy and Vision Loss
item.description: New study links semaglutide to rare optic nerve damage, highlighting the need for increased awareness, monitoring, and informed prescribing. The post Semaglutide Associated with Optic Neuropathy and Vision Loss appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Major Depressive Disorder Shares Immune Signature with AD
item.description: Major depressive disorder shares a Th2 immune signature with atopic dermatitis, highlighting dupilumab as a potential targeted therapy. The post Major Depressive Disorder Shares Immune Signature with AD appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Inside Virus Evolution: Interview with Edward Holmes
item.description: All human viruses ultimately come from animals, and humans transmit viruses to animals too, so it’s a two-way traffic. The post Inside Virus Evolution: Interview with Edward Holmes appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Strong Link Between Borderline Personality Disorder and Alcohol Use
item.description: Study shows alcohol use disorders affects 55% of people with borderline personality disorder, highlighting urgent need for integrated clinical care. The post Strong Link Between Borderline Personality Disorder and Alcohol Use appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Nearly Two-Thirds of Maternal Deaths Occur in Conflict Zones
item.description: The WHO has highlighted a surge in maternal deaths in conflict and fragile settings, where an estimated two-thirds of all maternal deaths occur. The post Nearly Two-Thirds of Maternal Deaths Occur in Conflict Zones appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Wildfire Smoke PM2.5 Linked to Thousands of Deaths
item.description: Major study finds chronic exposure to wildfire smoke PM2.5 linked to 24,000 USA deaths per year, with no safe threshold and strong neurological impacts. The post Wildfire Smoke PM2.5 Linked to Thousands of Deaths appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: First-Time NHS Breast Screening Attendance Hits 10-Year High
item.description: The number of women attending their first NHS mammogram has hit a 10-year high, NHS data has revealed. The post First-Time NHS Breast Screening Attendance Hits 10-Year High appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Actor’s death spotlights early-onset bowel cancer
item.description: James Van Der Beek’s death from bowel cancer has thrust rising colorectal cancer rates back into the spotlight. The post Actor’s death spotlights early-onset bowel cancer appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Rethinking UTIs: Interview with Florian Wagenlehner
item.description: UTIs cover a very broad area; there isn’t just one type. Therefore, we try to better classify them. Traditionally, UTIs are divided into uncomplicated and complicated infections...
